children.title: A demo store, built with Kotlin end to end
children.lead: Haul is an open showcase: a marketplace whose every page, command and order runs on one Kotlin stack, from the database to the pixels. Browse it, fill a cart, sign in, place an order and return it — nothing done here costs anything or reaches anybody.

points.name: Ktor on the JVM
points.text: The server: every page, every command and the order’s saga, over PostgreSQL. It starts from an AOT cache zavarnik trains when the image is built.

points.name: kompot
points.text: Every page is a tree of components the server builds and sends, and the browser draws. A filter, a stepper or a tab answers with only the parts that changed.

points.name: Compose Multiplatform in the browser
points.text: The storefront is Compose on Kotlin/Wasm; the same code draws the screenshot tests on the JVM.

points.name: petich
points.text: An order is a saga: stock, a delivery slot, points and the card are reserved in turn, and given back in reverse when a step fails.

points.name: shildik
points.text: Sign-in is an OpenID Connect provider of the project’s own, deployed beside the store — the sign-in page on another address is it.

points.name: Synthetic shoppers
points.text: Scripted shoppers walk the store every ten minutes — browse, buy, receive, return — so an order is always on its way.

points.name: tracy
points.text: Logs and traces of every request, each order’s saga one list in them; route metrics in metrik, crash reports in katcher.

points.name: The saga and its compensations
points.text: Placing an order reserves and authorises step by step; a declined card gives back everything taken before it, and a return is refunded.

points.name: The sellers, couriers and payments
points.text: Simulated inside the server, on a clock: shipments are packed, sent and delivered, a card is charged as its shipment leaves, and the four payments come due.

points.name: The observability
points.text: What the stand logs, traces and reports is what happened on it, the synthetic shoppers’ walks included.

points.name: Money
points.text: No money moves: the cards are the simulator’s, and nobody is charged.

points.name: Parcels
points.text: No parcel ships: a delivery is the simulator moving it along.

points.name: Products, reviews and sellers
points.text: Invented for the demo: the catalogue, its pictures, the reviews and the sellers are sample data. No brand sells here.
